name: Dimecoin
note: Mirror of BasicSwap's Dash integration (Dimecoin is a Dash X11 fork). Populate `electrum_servers` with a Dimecoin ElectrumX server the team operates, then submit this file to basicswap/basicswap as `coins/dimecoin.json`. Dimecoin reuses Bitcoin's xpub/xprv prefixes (0x0488B21E / 0x0488ADE4).
